## `vec_power`

*Available in [R](#vec_power-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to use power.t.test, power.prop.test, etc in
    vectorized fashion and return a table of results

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    vec_power(fun = stats::power.t.test, ...)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `fun` - a power calculating function; <function>
    - `...` - the arguments for the power calculating function assigned to `fun`;

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    tibble of results
